raw_prompt: !fix for the tnt boots. it was spawning while I was standing still. And then it just randomly stopped spawning permanently
reviewer_feedback: Updated the TNT boots logic to use a velocity threshold instead of checking for zero, ensuring consistent spawning while moving.
usage_instructions: Use /get-tnt-boots to receive the special diamond boots.
Equip the boots and move horizontally to spawn TNT behind you.

mutations.content:
command /get-tnt-boots:
    permission: op
    trigger:
        give 1 of diamond boots named "&cTNT Trail Boots" with lore "&7Leaves a trail of destruction behind you." to player

every 5 ticks:
    loop all players:
        if loop-player's boots is diamond boots named "&cTNT Trail Boots":
            set {_v} to velocity of loop-player
            set y-coordinate of {_v} to 0
            if vector length of {_v} > 0.1:
                if block under loop-player is not air:
                    set {_loc} to location of loop-player
                    set {_back} to location 1.5 meters behind loop-player
                    spawn primed tnt at {_back}
                    play sound "entity.tnt.primed" with volume 0.5 to loop-player

traces.intent_summary: Fix the TNT trail spawning logic to prevent spawning while stationary and ensure the effect persists correctly.

traces.rationale: The original script checked if velocity was exactly zero, which fails due to floating-point inaccuracies and minor server-side movement. I replaced this with a vector length check (ignoring Y-axis) to ensure TNT only spawns when the player is actively moving horizontally. I also reduced the distance behind the player to 1.5 meters to prevent spawning issues in tight spaces.

traces.user_summary: Updated the TNT boots logic to use a velocity threshold instead of checking for zero, ensuring consistent spawning while moving.
